query: Show my brand colours on a colour wheel: #1F6F5C, #F2C14E, #E76F51
expected_behavior: Opens wheel.html with the colours in the link: #c=1F6F5C,F2C14E,E76F51
Uses the platform's open command (open on Mac, start on Windows)
Explains in plain words how to add colours, read the list and use complements
Opens the wheel with both colours placed
Reads the segment numbers and says whether they are about 18 segments apart (complementary)
Answers in plain words, not only segment numbers

query: I need a complement for #F2C14E that's dark enough for body text on it
expected_behavior: Opens the wheel with F2C14E-4.5 in the link so its contrast target is 4.5:1
Tells them to switch on Show complements and read the complement's hex code and achieved contrast from the list
Mentions 4.5:1 is the AA level for body text, and 7:1 for AAA
